content: Kura nuiwarimama
Kura nuiwarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨni: Paretsi, Ketsiruni, Karimi, Kuxi meta Tsuwari.
Xehahiyaxi Tsuwari nu'aya Yakati paapaya kanayani, meta Yakati 'Akumahi paapaya kanayani meta Rakari. Mɨkɨ mekanakɨne tsuratitsixi nuiwariyari.
'Etami niwemama menakɨne: Ketsireri, 'Itsima meta 'Iwatsi. Wa'iwa 'uka katinitewakaitɨni Katsereripuni.
Metatsiere niwemama mekanakɨne: Penuheri, Keruxi paapaya, meta 'Etsexi, Kutsa paapaya. Mɨkɨ mekanakɨne Kuxi nuiwarimama, 'Epɨrata matɨarieya, Wereni paapaya.
'Atsuxi, Tekuha paapaya yuhutame 'ukarawetsixi kaniwarutiwitɨni, Hera meta Nahara.
Nahara 'Akutsani mamaaya patɨa meta Hepexi, Temeni meta 'Akatsitari. Mɨkɨ Nahara niwemama mekanakɨne.
Hera niwemama mekanakɨne: Tsereti, Yetsukaxi meta 'Etinahani.
Kuhutsi 'Anuwi 'ukiyarieya patɨa, meta Tsuwewa, metatsiere 'Akaxikeri tɨɨriyamama Haruni nu'aya.
Kawetsi waɨkawa rexeiyatɨ patɨa 'iwamama kememɨka'anekai. Kepauka mamaaya mɨyamɨtiterɨwaxɨ, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Netiuka'eniwatɨ nepitiniwexɨ».

Hikɨ Kawetsi 'Ixaheri Kakaɨyarieya mɨpaɨ pɨtiutawawiri: «'Aixɨa keneneyurieka, kwie 'eyeume keneneyetuiri, keneneparewieka, 'axamɨ'anetsie keneneuxɨna nemɨkatiuka'eniwanikɨ». Kakaɨyari yakatiniuyurieni kemɨtitawawiri.
Keruwi, Tsuka 'iwaya, Mekixi paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨta Mekixi 'Etsituni paapaya kanayani.
'Etsituni Weti-Xapaha paapaya kanayani meta Patsehaki metatsiere Tekina, 'Ixi-Nakatsi paapaya matɨa. Mɨkɨ mekanakɨne Xekaha kiekatari.
Kenatsi niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Utunieri meta Tserahiyaxi. 'Utunieri niwemama mekanakɨne: Katati
meta Mehunutahi, mɨkɨ 'Upɨra paapaya matɨa. Tserahiyaxi Kuhawi paapaya patɨa, mɨkɨta Ke-Karitsini kiekatari wapaapa patɨa, mana kiekatari tepɨakɨ te'uximayatamete memɨhɨkɨtɨkaikɨ.
Karewi niwemama Kepune nu'aya mekanakɨne: 'Ixi, 'Eraha meta Nuhani. 'Eraha Kenatsi paapaya kanayani.
Yarereri niwemama mekanakɨne: Tsipi, Tsipa, Tiriyaxi meta 'Atsareri.
'Etsitɨraxi niwemama mekanakɨne: Ketexi, Mereri, 'Epexi meta Karuni. Xewitɨ Mereri 'ɨyaya ―hetsiena kaniwarayexeiya: Miriyami, Tsamahi meta 'Itsiwa, 'Etsitemuha paapaya matɨa―

mɨkɨ Witiha katinitewakaitɨni Parahuni nu'aya. Xewitɨta Mereri 'ɨyaya Kura nuiwarieyatsie kanimiemetɨkaitɨni, mɨkɨ hamatɨa kaniwarayexeiya: Kereri, Keruxi paapaya, Hewexi, Tsuku paapaya, meta Kekutiheri, Tsanuha paapaya.
Kehira, Karimi tewiyari, meta 'Etsitemuha, Mahaka kiekame, mɨkɨ Huriyaxi 'ɨyaya niwemama mekanakɨne, tatsɨari, Nakani 'iwaya 'uka.
Tsimuni niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Aminuni, Xina, Weni-Kanani meta Tiruni. 'Itsi niwemama mekanakɨne: Tsuketi meta Weni-Tsuketi.
Tseraxi nuiwarimama Kura nu'aya mekanakɨne: 'Exi, Rekaha paapaya, Raraha, Maretsa paapaya, meta memɨte'uximaya rinutsie Weti-'Atsiweya kiekariyaritsie mepɨtɨɨriyamama,

metatsiere Tsera nuiwarimama mepakɨ Kuhakini, meta Kutsewa kiekariyaritsie kiekatari, Kuhatsi kiekatari meta Tsarape kiekatari, mɨkɨ (mɨpaɨ paine 'utɨarika meripai mieme) kename meka'akunuaxɨawawetɨ Werenitsie 'ukarawetsixi muhawitsixi mewarutiwitɨ.
Mɨkɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni 'iwewamete Netahini memɨkiekataritɨkai meta Kerera, mana mekaniyuhayewa ti'aitame mete'uximayatsirietɨ.
Tsimehuni nuiwarimama
Tsimehuni nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: Nemuheri, Kamini, Kariwi, Tsera meta Tsahuri.
Tsahuri nu'aya kanayani: Tsaruni, Tsaruni nu'aya Miwitsani kanayani, Miwitsani nu'aya Mitsima kanayani.
Mitsima nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: Kamuheri, Tsakuxi meta Tsimi.

Tsimi tamamata heimana 'ataxewime yuniwema 'ukitsi kaniwarayexeiya meta me'ataxewime 'ukari, peru 'iwamama 'etsiwa xeikɨa mepɨwarayexei tɨɨri, 'ayumieme watɨɨriyama waɨkawa mepɨka'utamɨirixɨ Kura nuiwarimama kememɨyɨ.
Weritsewa mekanikuyaxe meta Murara, Katsaxi-Tsuhari,
Wiriha, 'Etseni, Turari,
Wetuheri, Kuxima, Tsikɨraki,
Weti-Marikawuti, Katsaxi-Tsutsini, Weti-Wirahi meta Tsakarahini. Mɨkɨ wakiekarite kanayani kepaukake Rawiri mɨtiuta'aitaxɨ.
Wakiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu kanayani 'Etami, 'Ahini, Ximuni, Tukeni meta 'Atsani ―naitɨ 'auxɨwitɨ patɨa―,
meta 'akuxi 'iya kiekari 'aurie mamanetɨkatei metatsiere Wahari kwieyaritsiepaitɨ. Mɨkɨ wakie kanayani, kemaine kememɨteheukunuiwa xapayari.
Metsuwawi, Kamɨreki, Kutsiyaxi 'Amatsiyaxi nu'aya,
Kuheri, Kehu Kutsiwiyaxi nu'aya, Tserahiyaxi nu'aya, 'Atsiheri nu'aya,
'Erihuhenahi, Kakuwa, Yetsukahiyaxi, 'Atsahiyaxi, 'Arieri, Ketsimiheri, Wenahiyaxi,
Tsitsa Tsipi nu'aya, 'Aruhuni nu'aya, Kerahiyaxi nu'aya, Tsimɨri nu'aya, Tsemahiyaxi nu'aya:
'Ikɨ meyunaitɨ memanuyetei mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni yutɨɨriyama wahetsie. Watɨɨriyama waɨkawa memutamɨirixɨkɨ,
mekanekɨne Keruxi manayenieretsie, mayeweri tau manatineika hepatsie, 'ɨxa meheuwautɨkaitɨ yutewama wahetsiemieme.
Mana mekanitaxeiya 'ɨxa 'aixɨa 'aneneme waɨkawame, kwie 'eyeukame, kayuwatɨ 'umakaku. Mana mekanititekaitɨni meripaitɨ Kami nuiwarimama.

Memanuyetei 'ari memutiterɨwarie meniu'axɨani 'Etsekiyaxi ti'aitakaku Kura kwieyaritsie. Mekaniwarutakwini Kami nuiwarimama meta kii kepaɨmeme memukaxei naime mekaniuti'una. Mana waɨkawa 'ɨxa muxuawekaikɨ watewama wahetsiemieme, mana mekaniuyuhayewa, hikɨ 'akuxi mana mekanekuteni.

'Auxɨwime tsienituyari kuyaxi, Tsimehuni nuiwarimama memɨhɨkɨtɨkai, meniwanɨ'akaitɨni Peratiyaxi, Nehariyaxi, Xepahiyaxi meta 'Utsiheri, 'Itsi niwemama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni, Tsehixi hɨriyaritsie mekanekɨne.
Mewarukwika 'Amareki teɨterimama memutawikwekai mana memukutekai, mana mekaniuyuhayewa, hikɨ 'akuxi mana mekanetiteni.
